newsitem.title: DUBAI: S.Arabia's King Fahd chaired cabinet meeting Thurs.
newsitem.headline: S.Arabia's King Fahd chaired cabinet meeting Thurs.

text.p: Saudi Arabia's King Fahd presided over a cabinet meeting in the holy city of Mecca on Thursday night, Saudi state television said on Friday.
It showed pictures of King Fahd chairing the weekly meeting.
King Fahd traditionally spends the last 10 days of the Moslem fasting month of Ramadan, which this year is expected to end in the second week of February, in holy sites in western Saudi Arabia.
